rationale: The bid-ask spread of 519 bps makes any entry immediately unprofitable by a significant margin, as the cost to cross the spread alone would consume a large portion of any realistic intraday move. The stock has gapped down 13.6% with no news context available, making directional conviction impossible — the gap could be a catalyst-driven flush or a liquidity-driven overshoot with no way to distinguish. The 5-minute ATR of $0.16 is extremely small relative to the spread width, meaning the instrument lacks the intraday range to overcome transaction costs even if direction were correct.
